title: Soft Shopping
equation: Exit Value = Buyer Confidence × Strategic Fit × Reduced Risk
hook: The best time to hear what buyers think of your business is years before you want to sell.
statement: Test buyer interest before you're ready to sell. Their pushback becomes your clearest plan for raising value.
explainer: You're not begging for a deal. You're gathering intel. Every hesitation a buyer has tells you exactly what the market doesn't trust yet. That's a to-do list handed to you.
sop: Find a few potential buyers or experienced advisors.
Walk them through the business honestly.
Ask what would stop them from paying more.
Write down the objections that keep coming up.
Turn those objections into next year's operating plan.
equation_example: Buyer Confidence 6, Strategic Fit 8, Reduced Risk 5. 6 × 8 × 5 = 240 Exit Value, out of 1,000. Higher means buyers move fast and pay close to asking. Lower means every conversation stalls on the same objections.
question: Write down the one thing a buyer would point to today as a reason not to pay a premium.
closing_statement: Let the market price your blind spots.
